# Tony Visuals

> Photographer based in Cairo, Egypt — live performances, events, and dramatic portraiture.

Tony Visuals documents live shows, events, and one-on-one portraits with an eye for strong lighting and precise timing. Bookings are accepted worldwide; sessions are agreed individually by email.
